segments.sensitive: One reviewer with sensitive skin reports the patches work well and has never had a breakout from using them.
segments.combination: Two reviewers with combination skin say the salicylic acid works well for their skin type and helps remove whiteheads overnight.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her thirties and another describing herself as nearly fifty both report positive results, wishing the patches had existed when they were younger.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report spots and pimples visibly shrink, dry up, or flatten overnight, including deep or under-the-skin spots; a few report no visible difference or even spots looking bigger.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers describe blemishes clearing faster, with gunk or pus extracted overnight; one notes it can take a couple of days to fully draw out.
concerns.redness: Multiple reviewers note redness and inflammation reduced or gone by morning; no dissent reported.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer contrasts these patches favorably, saying other brands left skin dry around the pimple but these did not.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with combination skin reports the patches help remove whiteheads and control oily clogged pores overnight.
